changeSet.comment: SCHEDULE_TM_INTERVAL_ID on TRADE.DEPLOYMENT — which cadence this deployment runs on
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE TRADE.DEPLOYMENT ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS SCHEDULE_TM_INTERVAL_ID INTEGER;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE TRADE.DEPLOYMENT DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS SCHEDULE_TM_INTERVAL_ID;

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Backfill SCHEDULE_TM_INTERVAL_ID = DAILY (1) on current open deployments
changeSet.sql: UPDATE TRADE.DEPLOYMENT SET SCHEDULE_TM_INTERVAL_ID = 1 WHERE SCHEDULE_TM_INTERVAL_ID IS NULL AND TRANSACT_TO_TS = TIMESTAMPTZ '9999-12-31 00:00:00+00';

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: TRADE.DEPLOYMENT_SCHEDULE_STATUS — scheduler state separate from EXECUTION_EVENT

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Seed schedule rows for open deployments — next due from latest successful apply, else deployment start
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO TRADE.DEPLOYMENT_SCHEDULE_STATUS ( DEPLOYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID, DEPLOYMENT_SCHEDULE_VID, DEPLOYMENT_ID, DEPLOYMENT_VID, STATUS, SCHEDULED_TS, IS_CURRENT_IND, USER_ID, CREATED_AT ) SELECT d.DEPLOYMENT_ID, 1, d.DEPLOYMENT_ID, d.DEPLOYMENT_VID, CASE WHEN d.DEPLOYMENT_STATUS IN ('STOPPED', 'PAUSED') OR d.IS_ENABLED_IND = 'N' THEN 'SUCCESS' ELSE 'PENDING' END, COALESCE(lr.TRANSACT_AT + ti.PERIOD_LENGTH, d.TRANSACT_FROM_TS), 'Y', d.USER_ID, NOW() FROM TRADE.DEPLOYMENT d JOIN REFDATA.TM_INTERVAL ti ON ti.TM_INTERVAL_ID = d.SCHEDULE_TM_INTERVAL_ID LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT e.TRANSACT_AT FROM TRADE.EXECUTION_EVENT e WHERE e.DEPLOYMENT_ID = d.DEPLOYMENT_ID AND e.IS_SUCCESS_IND = 'Y' ORDER BY e.TRANSACT_AT DESC LIMIT 1 ) lr ON TRUE WHERE d.TRANSACT_TO_TS = TIMESTAMPTZ '9999-12-31 00:00:00+00' AND d.SCHEDULE_TM_INTERVAL_ID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRADE.DEPLOYMENT_SCHEDULE_STATUS ss WHERE ss.DEPLOYMENT_ID = d.DEPLOYMENT_ID );
